microservices_endpoint_backlog.engineering_rationale: This microservice is required to provide real-time inventory tracking and analytics for ElectroCore Recycling Matrix's customers, aligning with Stage 2 strategy
This microservice is necessary for ElectroCore Recycling Matrix to analyze and optimize lithium battery recycling processes, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations
This microservice enables ElectroCore Recycling Matrix to manage and optimize recycling facility operations, streamlining the recycling process

core_mvp_feature_1.functional_technical_description: Implement real-time inventory tracking using Apache Kafka and Amazon DynamoDB to provide customers with up-to-date information on available battery types and quantities.
core_mvp_feature_1.vrio_defensibility_link: This feature maps back to Value (enhanced customer experience), Rarity (unique offering in the CleanTech Lithium Battery Infrastructure Optimization sector), and Inimitability (patent-pending technology for real-time inventory tracking)

core_mvp_feature_2.functional_technical_description: Develop a machine learning-based analysis service using Apache Cassandra to optimize lithium battery recycling processes, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations.
core_mvp_feature_2.vrio_defensibility_link: This feature maps back to Value (enhanced customer experience through optimized recycling processes), Rarity (unique offering in the CleanTech Lithium Battery Infrastructure Optimization sector), and Inimitability (patent-pending technology for lithium battery analysis and optimization)
